finding: Filename/suffix-based enumeration of canonical Experience records (used through E46) silently omitted 4 real records that existed in files whose names did not match the assumed pattern (project-brain-experience-e10-capture-v1.json, project-brain-experience-e19-capture-v1.json, project-brain-experience-e47-capture-v1.json, project-brain-experience-e10-e9-result-capture-v1.json).

rules.statement: Canonical Experience loading MUST use structural signature matching (experience_id/phase/experience_kind/links.goal_ref/decision/result all present) over every .json file in the directory, never a filename or suffix pattern.

Any experience_id containing "test_fixture" MUST be excluded from the canonical set regardless of where it is stored, to prevent synthetic test data (e.g. E43-style fixtures) from being counted as real.
A cross-file duplicate experience_id (same id found via structural scan in more than one file) is a fail-closed condition and must be reported, never silently deduplicated by overwrite.
Every future phase that must enumerate canonical Experience records reuses this structural loader verbatim; it must not reintroduce filename-keyed enumeration as the primary loading mechanism.
